A '''traitor''' was active within the [[Wordro's organization|organization]] of [[Wordro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Hijacker Ambush" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> a companion of an individual associated with one of the two rival governments, sent to investigate hijackings of the organization's shipments, exposed the traitor.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The traitor active in Wordro the Hutt's organization was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Hijacker Ambush" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's completion was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
